#include <string>

string process_string() {
    for (int index = 1; index < static_cast<int>(s.size()) - 2; ++index) {
        if (s[index] == 'a' && s[index + 1] == 't') {
            s.erase(index, 2);
            s.insert(index, "@");
            break;
        }
    }
    for (int index = 1; index < static_cast<int>(s.size()) - 3; ++index) {
        if (s[index] == 'd' && s[index + 1] == 'o' && s[index + 2] == 't') {
            s.erase(index, 3);
            s.insert(index, ".");
        }
    }
    return s;
}

int main() {
    string input;
    while (cin >> input) {
        s = input;
        cout << process_string() << endl;
    }
